cues.en: the the essential problem with failure detection in our world with the world's funniest joke. And this is actually true. There was some kind of study about how humans respond to humor and all this kind of stuff. This was decided to be the funniest joke in the world. Not that joke. cues.zh: 在我们的世界里，故障检测的核心难题。这个笑话是真的。曾经有人做过一项研究，研究人们对幽默的反应之类的东西。他们认定这是世界上最好笑的笑话。不是那个笑话。我觉得，世界上最好笑的笑话应该是那个。但他们没问我。所以，这才是世界上真正最好笑的笑话。两个猎人进了树林，好吗？其中一个突然倒下，眼睛翻白，看起来情况很糟。他的同伴走过去，也不知道该怎么办，就掏出手机拨打 911，说：「我朋友躺在这儿。我觉得他死了。我该怎么办？」接线员说：「等一下，等一下，冷静下来。首先，确认他死了。」然后，电话那头安静了下来，接着传来一声枪响。那人说：「好了。」

cues.en: Now what?
cues.zh: 现在怎么办？

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 而且

cues.en: this is the essential problem with doing failure detection in our world,
cues.zh: 这正是我们这个领域做故障检测的核心难题所在，

cues.en: that there is no real way to tell
cues.zh: 就是你根本没办法确切判断

cues.en: that a server or a component has actually failed. And in the old days, there was. Right? We talked about commodity hardware, and this is really a commodity hardware problem. If I go way back in time to when I was still young,
cues.zh: 一台服务器或一个组件是否真的宕机了。在过去，确实有办法，对吧？我们之前聊过商用硬件，这其实就是商用硬件带来的问题。如果回到我很年轻的那个时代，

cues.en: we had techniques like IO fencing, where we could use hardware
cues.zh: 我们有像 IO fencing 这样的技术，可以通过硬件

cues.en: to say, okay, that server, I want that server no longer to be able to communicate with the rest of my cluster. So I want him fenced off. And now I've shot him. I know he's dead. We can't do that anymore. So the essential problem with failure detection is being able to tell that a server has died. So
cues.zh: 来指定：那台服务器，我不许它再和集群中的其他机器通信。直接把它隔离出去。这就像一枪把它崩了，我确信它死透了。但现在我们没法这么做了。所以故障检测的根本难题，就是怎么确定一台服务器真的宕了。所以

cues.en: one thing... So, know, one common way to do that is you listen to a server. When the server stops responding, you say, well, I think that server might have failed.
cues.zh: 有一点……通常的做法是去监听服务器。当服务器不再响应时，你就会想：嗯，这台服务器大概挂了吧。

cues.en: One of the many problems with that is that it could be that the server's fine, and it's actually the network that's failed. Right? So is it him that's failed or is it me that's failed? I really can't tell.
cues.zh: 这样做的许多问题之一是，服务器可能没问题，真正出故障的是网络。对吧？那到底是服务器出故障了，还是我这边出了故障？我实在分辨不出来。

cues.en: And it's just a theoretical
cues.zh: 这只是理论上的

cues.en: thing that you can't avoid that you will have false positives. You will decide that some server has failed when it really has not. So what can we do about that? Well, we've got a few techniques. And the most common technique that we use for failure detection in general is not to try to detect failure, but to detect liveness.
cues.zh: 问题：误报是不可避免的。你可能会判断某台服务器出了故障，但实际上它并没有。那么我们能怎么办？我们有几种方法。一般来说，最常用的故障检测方法不是去检测故障，而是检测服务器是否存活。

cues.en: So have a heartbeat protocol. And while I may not be able to reason
cues.zh: 所以要有心跳协议。虽然我可能无法推断

cues.en: that a particular server has failed,
cues.zh: 某台特定服务器已经故障，

cues.en: I can reason that he's alive, that I have a communication path to that server and I'm receiving heartbeats. So heartbeat protocols are super useful. We use them all over the place. The gossip based protocol that I talked about that we built for S3 is essentially this sort of mechanism.
cues.zh: 但我可以推断它还活着，我与那台服务器之间有通信路径，而且我在接收心跳。所以心跳协议非常有用。我们到处都在用。我讲过的那个为 S3 构建的基于 gossip 的协议，本质上就是这类机制。

cues.en: When I stop seeing in my little table that's, you know, about who's in my group, if I haven't received a heartbeat through the, you know, through the epidemic algorithm from some server in a while, I conclude that that server's probably failed. The other technique
cues.zh: 当我在那张记录组内成员的小表里，如果有一阵子没通过流行病算法从某台服务器收到心跳，我就断定那台服务器很可能已经故障了。另一项

cues.en: that we recommend using that should be used is is using leasing
cues.zh: 我们推荐使用、也应该使用的技术是租约

cues.en: rather than locking. Right? So it's a basic computer science idea, programming idea, that if you have some resource that you don't want concurrent access to, you establish a lock on that resource. Right? And this works great if you're writing like a Java program because of what I said earlier. If some if some object has something locked, then unless you write, you know,
cues.zh: 而不是锁。对吧？这是一个基本的计算机科学概念、编程概念：如果你有个资源不希望被并发访问，你就在那个资源上加锁。对吧？如果你写的是 Java 程序，这非常管用，因为我之前说过。如果某个对象被锁住了，那么除非你写，你知道，

cues.en: it does happen from time to time. But typically with code, if that
cues.zh: 这种情况确实时不时会发生。但通常在代码里，如果

cues.en: object fails, your whole JVM has failed. So you don't have to worry about the lock being kept. Whereas in a distributed system, if I assign a lock to some server and that server fails, now my resource is unavailable, maybe forever.
cues.zh: 对象失效了，整个 JVM 也就失效了。所以你不用担心锁一直被占用。而在分布式系统中，如果我把锁分配给某台服务器，而这台服务器失效了，那资源就无法使用了，可能永远都用不了。

cues.en: So a better protocol is to have that server obtain a lease on some resource.
cues.zh: 更好的协议是让服务器获取某个资源的租约。

cues.en: And then that server has to reason about this as well. Right? If the server has a lease for seven hundred milliseconds,
cues.zh: 然后服务器也得考虑这个问题，对吧？如果服务器的租约只有七百毫秒，

cues.en: and it can't get its work done in seven hundred milliseconds, it has to know to stop touching that resource.
cues.zh: 而它没法在七百毫秒内完成工作，就得知道该停止访问那个资源。

cues.en: But this is another technique we use to deal with failure detection. So here are the lessons around failure detection. Don't let components go silent. Silence in a distributed system is very, very hard to deal with because you can't tell the difference between somebody who's just resting and somebody who's failed.
cues.zh: 但这是我们用来处理故障检测的另一种技术。以下是关于故障检测的经验教训：别让组件陷入沉默。分布式系统中的沉默极难处理，因为你无法分辨它只是在歇着，还是已经挂了。

cues.en: The second one is try to get protocols that don't rely on accurate failure detection. The most easy way to deal with this is to not rely on your failure detection being correct.
cues.zh: 第二点是，尽量采用不依赖精准故障检测的协议。应对这个问题最简单的办法，就是别指望你的故障检测绝对准确。

cues.en: Then you can have more hair trigger failure detection and still get correct results. And finally, like I said, use leases instead of locks. Yeah.
cues.zh: 这样你就能做到更灵敏的故障检测，同时依然保证结果正确。最后，就像我说的，用租约代替锁。就是这样。
